findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key does not set enable_key_rotation, so automatic annual rotation is disabled (default false). Long-lived key material increases exposure if the key is ever compromised and violates CIS AWS Foundations control for KMS key rotation.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root (and thus any IAM principal with KMS permissions) full control over the key used to encrypt the logs bucket, rather than a least-privilege policy limited to the log-writing and log-reading principals.
